articles.title: Ditching 'digital gold': BPI study suggests everyday Americans prefer control and micro-investing
articles.snippet: A new survey suggests some of bitcoin's most familiar sales pitches of changing the world may be poorly suited to a majority of prospective buyers.

articles.title: Ripple is preparing XRP Ledger for quantum computers before ‘Q-Day’ arrives
articles.snippet: An Anthropic model cut the work needed to break a leading post-quantum signature candidate by a factor of 67 million last month, while Bitcoin and Ethereum published their own migration plans this week.

articles.title: Stellar tokenized RWA market more than quadruples to nearly $4B
articles.snippet: Stellar’s real-world asset market has expanded rapidly this year as institutional adoption and tokenization activity grow across the network.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin pumps, Wall Street does the paperwork

articles.title: Polish Olympic chief charged in Zondacrypto probe, justice minister says
articles.snippet: Polish Olympic Committee president Radosław Piesiewicz faces charges as prosecutors investigate his ties to collapsed cryptocurrency exchange Zondacrypto.
